results.title: r/Substack on Reddit: Are you concerned about AI scraping your Substack posts? How do you protect your work?
results.snippet: To my knowledge, Substack doesn’t seem to block this fully unless we take extra steps and opt-out from AI training. It’s making me question how safe it is to post anything original. So I'm left wondering, as Substack writers, how are you handling this? Are you paywalling everything from the start to protect your work?

results.title: Content Guidelines
results.snippet: If you are importing a mailing list from another platform, you are required to ensure it’s made up of people who explicitly opted-in to receive emails from your specific publication.
